# Regent Protocol

> Regent is the financial authorization and compliance layer for AI agents that move money: a verifiable identity for every agent (AgentID), spending mandates it cannot exceed, Guardian risk controls, and tamper-evident audit evidence anchored on Solana. Live on Solana devnet; production availability follows published status.

KYA — Know Your Agent — is Regent's product framework for connecting an autonomous agent to a responsible context, financial mandate, and verifiable audit history. It is not a formal regulatory standard.

## Pages

- [Home](https://regentprotocol.org/): what Regent does — the financial action flow from AgentID through mandate check, Guardian decision, and audit proof
- [Technology](https://regentprotocol.org/technology): architecture — Solana settlement programs (devnet), Celestia DA audit storage, Guardian risk engine, Python SDK
- [Pricing](https://regentprotocol.org/pricing): usage-based launch pricing — Developer $0, Growth $299/mo, Scale $999/mo, Enterprise from $2,500/mo; the unit is a verified action, never seats
- [Pilot Program](https://regentprotocol.org/pilot): structured 14-day engagement; application form online
- [About](https://regentprotocol.org/about): team and thesis
- [Terms of Use](https://regentprotocol.org/terms) · [Privacy Policy](https://regentprotocol.org/privacy)

## Developer resources

- [Documentation](https://docs.regentprotocol.org): quickstart, Python SDK (`pip install regent`), REST API, Solana programs — machine-readable index at [docs llms.txt](https://docs.regentprotocol.org/llms.txt)
- [Verify on-chain](https://docs.regentprotocol.org/solana-programs/verification): independently check agents, mandates, and audit events against Solana
